## AI Internal Linking — RankerMind
This workflow powers the "AI Internal Linking" WordPress plugin.

Setup:
1. Open the Ollama Generate node and create/select an Ollama credential pointing at your Ollama base URL (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:11434).
2. Pull the model named in the plugin settings (default llama3.1:8b) in Ollama.
3. Activate the workflow and copy the production Webhook URL into the plugin Settings (same URL for Find and Audit).

The plugin owns all data; this workflow is a stateless processor.
